Kaizer Chiefs vs Orlando Pirates: Kickoff time, TV deets, key info
The biggest day on any calendar.
Kaizer Chiefs and Orlando Pirates lock horns in the Soweto Derby. It might be a last-chance saloon moment for both clubs in the league title chase.
Soweto Derby key details
- How to watch: The match will air on SuperSport’s DStv channel 202 (SuperSport PSL) and SABC 1.
- Date: Saturday, Feb. 28 at 15:30 CAT
- Venue: FNB Stadium, Johannesburg
Could Dlamini leave Orlando Pirates and excel with Kaizer Chiefs?
Abdeslam Ouaddou has admitted that Kabelo Dlamini has battled injuries this season. Kaizer Chiefs and Bafana Bafana legend Tsepo Masilela would like to see the left-footer in Amakhosi colours, via SoccerBeat.
Likely Soweto Derby starting XIs
Chiefs lost 2-1 to Stellenbosch in midweek, which could necessitate changes to their starting XI. Pirates also had a disappointing result last time out, getting dumped out of the Nedbank Cup by Casric Stars on penalties. Here’s how both Soweto rivals could line up.
Kaizer Chiefs monitoring Ghanaian midfielder
Meanwhile, according to Soccer Laduma, Danish clubs Midtjylland and Randers, as well as Tanzanian side Azam, are monitoring 20-year-old Ghanaian midfielder Hubert Gyau. He’s on the books of Asanta Katoko and has scored four times in 21 league appearances this term. He’s contracted to Prosport International, and CEO agent Mike Makaab says they have not had any official approaches from any club as far as he knows.
